content:
maya: @channel customers reporting intermittent streaming timeouts -> 504s for hosted /v1/chat-stream since ~09:05 UTC. multiple accounts affected, attaching example request id req_8f3a9b2.

sahil: Oncall here, looking. any recent deploys?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout runtime v1.12.4 at 09:01 UTC to pool-hosted-rt-canary.

emily: Observability: p50/p90 latency climbed ~2x around 09:05 and edge 504s spike. metrics show burst on streaming-conns + edge upstream timeouts.

leo: Logs show streaming connector sending RSTs and proxies reporting "upstream response timeout" repeatedly. also seeing gRPC half-close events.

maya: Customer repro (from support): open websocket, send ~2.5k token prompt, stream stalls around token ~800 consistently, client sees 504 after ~60s.

sahil: Plan to isolate: disable streaming fallthrough to non-streaming path for a small canary. or flip edge proxy to buffering mode for /v1/chat-stream. propose 5% canary first.

emily: Mitigation 1 - increase upstream timeout 60s -> 120s on edge for the route. applying now.

deploy-bot: change applied: edge-proxy-timeout /v1/chat-stream canary=5% at 09:22 UTC.

jordan: Billing/service note: some customers report token billing stops when stream fails mid-response. we should note that retries may double-charge if clients retry aggressively.

maya: Sent brief customer comms: "we're investigating; please avoid aggressive retries. we'll follow up with repro and ETA." linking logs request.

leo: Runtime insight: KV-cache eviction pressure on long sessions; when tokens accumulate > ~800 we see eviction & recompute bumps that stall output. combined with proxy timeouts this yields client 504s. repro script: `python repro/stream_slow.py --tokens 2500 --ack-delay 0.4s`.

sahil: Action owners: 1) leo -> increase kvcache ceiling on canary + investigate eviction policy, 2) emily -> edge timeout buffer and monitoring, 3) maya -> customer comms and ticketing, 4) sahil -> lead postmortem.

maya: Filed incident INC-3290011 in PagerDuty and created internal ticket. shared initial customer-safe update.

emily: Observability followup: add a span/metric to surface streaming token ack delays and sidecar backpressure. filing OBS-204.

sahil: Canary results: after timeout + buffering fallback error rate dropped from 18% -> 1.2% over 12 minutes for affected customers. keep monitoring.

maya: Customer update sent: three high-usage customers validated reduced immediate 504s; a few long-tail failures remain. they'll validate tomorrow.

leo: Postmortem action items (short): a) raise default KV cache ceiling and tune eviction thresholds, b) implement client backpressure hints (early ACKs), c) enhance streaming proxy retry/backoff logic, d) add synthetic test for sustained long-stream sessions. i'll own a-c, emily will own d.

sahil: I'll draft the postmortem doc and action tracker: https://redwood.incidents/pm/INC-3290011 (placeholder).

maya: thanks all :heart: closing this war room for now, moving discussion to #postmortems and #product. will follow up tomorrow with stakeholders.
